verdict.rationale: Claude's own docs confirm uploading PDF, DOCX, CSV, XLSX and other formats, and say it analyzes text and visual elements in PDFs. That analysis is documented only for PDFs of 100 pages or fewer, and spreadsheet analysis is described only as 'work with'. missing for 10: explicit documentation of spreadsheet or data analysis on uploaded XLSX/CSV, evidence on accuracy (no hands-on or independent corroboration), analysis of PDFs over 100 pages.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents

citations.quote: Claude can work with the following document types: - PDF - DOCX - CSV - TXT - HTML - ODT - RTF - EPUB - JSON - XLSX
Claude analyzes both text and visual elements (like images, charts, and graphics) in PDFs of 100 pages or fewer
Files can be uploaded to individual chats or uploaded to a project's Files section for persistent reference across conversations.
